title: Opus 5.5 + Blender is pretty great
author: Aromatic-Low-4578
selftext:
"model a handgun in blender"

I'm running some custom modeling skills and this is only a first test but 5.5 seems like it will likely dethrone Astra for this kind of work. Thoroughly impressed.

comments.author: Intelligent-Cap-8886
comments.body: Astra was king of the hill for like a week... Crazy...

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Oh, I should also add that this is an in-progress screenshot. It's still working and has added a ton more detail.  I'll post a shot of the completed model when it's done.
